data.description:
## Context / Problem

Planning consumes `requires_create` and `requires_parent` in `ticket_planner.py:74-82,192` and `batch_dispatch.py:524`, but production builders at `run_differs.py:568` and `create_route.py:210-216` do not emit them. A parent and child created in one pass can therefore reach Jira in the wrong order.

## Approach

Have production mutation builders attach the existing metadata whenever an operation needs its parent/create edge. Preserve current planner semantics and prove the dispatcher never applies a dependent child before its parent mapping exists.

## Scope

- mutation types and production builders
- `run_differs.py`, `create_route.py`, planner, and batch dispatch
- focused reconciliation create/dispatch tests

## Testing

Cover a parent/child create batch, unrelated creates, missing parent mapping, and ordering under dispatch batching.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Production mutation construction emits `requires_create` and `requires_parent` for every applicable edge.
- [ ] Planner ordering places required parent/create operations before dependent child operations.
- [ ] Dispatcher coverage proves the child does not apply before its parent mapping exists.
- [ ] Unrelated creates retain current ordering and no-op behavior.
data.title: Emit and enforce reconciliation create-order dependency metadata
